snippet.title: Space Station Building Survival Roguelite - Devlog 02 - Campaign Progression
snippet.description:
This is the second devlog for a roguelite station-building survival game about keeping a fragile fleet alive in a hostile galaxy - Against the Storm meets Kerbal Space Program, with a bit more despair. 

Follow Along:
🔔 Subscribe to this channel for more devlogs
📬 Newsletter: https://tinyurl.com/msckjs2h

Project Overview:
You command Earth's three last ark ships as they travel from system to system in a hostile galaxy. 

In each new system, you build a temporary space station to turn raw materials into the energy needed for your next jump.

In This Video
In Devlog 2 I share a first look at the 'Intermission' - the campaign layer view between each stationbuilding mission.

In this mode you will plan your next mission while managing the deterioriation of your fleet. 

Everything is a tradeoff; repair broken systems, research new tech, or let your crew recover from the growing sense of madness and dread borne of the void. 

Next steps
From here the focus is on moving toward a playable demo with balanced systems.

01:36 Repair, Research, Recover
